meta.name: offensive-business-logic
meta.description: Business logic vulnerability testing for web/mobile/API engagements. Covers workflow bypass, state machine violations, multi-step process abuse, price/quantity/discount manipulation, currency confusion, coupon stacking, refund/chargeback abuse, race conditions on logic boundaries, parameter tampering for hidden flows, role/tenant boundary violations, time-of-check vs use, anti-automation defeat, fraud-detection evasion, and subscription/quota abuse. Use when scoping an application after surface-level OWASP Top 10 has been covered, or when the asset is a transactional/marketplace/fintech/e-commerce/SaaS app where logic flaws produce direct financial impact.

copy.tagline: 检测业务逻辑漏洞，防止被利用造成经济损失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责安全测试且应用涉及交易、支付或订阅等业务逻辑。
copy.tagline_en: Detect business logic flaws to prevent financial exploitation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you perform security testing on transactional or fintech applications.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你测试业务逻辑漏洞，比如绕过工作流、篡改价格、滥用优惠券、利用竞态条件等，并给出具体的测试步骤和示例请求。
howto.when: 当你在测试一个交易型、市场、金融、电商或SaaS应用，且已经完成基础的OWASP Top 10测试后，可以启用此技能。

say.text: 帮我测试这个电商应用的优惠券叠加漏洞。
say.note: Claude会给出测试步骤和示例请求。

say.text: 检查这个支付流程中是否存在价格篡改风险。
say.note: Claude会分析并给出测试方法。

say.text: 测试这个应用的竞态条件漏洞，比如并行退款。
say.note: Claude会提供并发请求的测试思路。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you test business logic vulnerabilities such as workflow bypass, price manipulation, coupon abuse, and race conditions, providing step-by-step testing methods and example requests.
howto.when_en: Use when testing a transactional, marketplace, fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS application after basic OWASP Top 10 testing is complete.

say_en.text: Help me test coupon stacking vulnerabilities in this e-commerce app.
say_en.note: Claude will provide test steps and example requests.

say_en.text: Check this payment flow for price manipulation risks.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest testing methods.

say_en.text: Test race conditions in this app, like parallel refunds.
say_en.note: Claude will provide concurrency testing ideas.
